response.sql: WITH linked AS (SELECT DISTINCT f.film_id, f.rating FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id), counts AS (SELECT rating, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM linked GROUP BY rating), shares AS (SELECT rating, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM counts) AS share FROM counts), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS a FROM shares), kept AS (SELECT s.rating, s.cnt, s.share, a.a FROM shares s, avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.a) SELECT COUNT(*) AS rating_count, SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - a) AS avg_excess FROM kept
